title: Visual Node Package
description: A node library package (docs/language-breadth.md, "Node library versioning"): a workspace file named *.vgraph-package.json listing node definition files, with a version graphs remember.

version.description: A semantic version. A new major version marks the package's nodes in graphs made with the old one for Refresh Node.

nodes.description: The node definition files it holds, relative to this file (globs allowed).

dependencies.description: Package names with version ranges, such as "^1.2.0".

blueprint.description: The extension API versions it works with, such as "^1".
